requirements.text: The game must be named 'Dojo Duel'.
requirements.check: The game window title displays 'Dojo Duel'.
requirements.quote: Create a tiny one-screen 2D fighting game called "Dojo Duel".

requirements.text: Player controls a red-belt martial artist on the left.
requirements.check: A red-belt fighter sprite is visible on the left side of the screen at game start.
requirements.quote: The player controls a red-belt martial artist on the left

requirements.text: A blue-belt rival controlled by the computer stands on the right.
requirements.check: A blue-belt fighter sprite is visible on the right side of the screen at game start, and moves autonomously.
requirements.quote: a blue-belt rival controlled by the computer stands on the right.

requirements.text: Both fighters stand on a plain wooden-brown floor.
requirements.check: A wooden-brown rectangular area is drawn at the bottom of the screen, and both fighters are positioned on top of it.
requirements.quote: Use a plain wooden-brown floor

requirements.text: The background should be a light colour.
requirements.check: The background of the game window is a light, solid color.
requirements.quote: a light background colour instead of a background image.

requirements.text: Both fighters are affected by gravity.
requirements.check: After jumping, both fighters fall back to the floor.
requirements.quote: Both fighters stand on the floor with gravity.

requirements.text: Left arrow key walks the player left.
requirements.check: Pressing the Left arrow key moves the player character to the left.
requirements.quote: The Left and Right arrow keys walk the player

requirements.text: Right arrow key walks the player right.
requirements.check: Pressing the Right arrow key moves the player character to the right.
requirements.quote: The Left and Right arrow keys walk the player

requirements.text: Up arrow key makes the player jump.
requirements.check: Pressing the Up arrow key makes the player character move upwards, then fall due to gravity.
requirements.quote: the Up arrow jumps

requirements.text: Space key makes the player throw a punch.
requirements.check: Pressing the Space key triggers a punch animation or action from the player character.
requirements.quote: Space throws a punch.

requirements.text: A punch that lands knocks the opponent back with a physics push.
requirements.check: When a punch connects, the opponent's position shifts away from the attacker.
requirements.quote: A punch that lands knocks the opponent back with a physics push

requirements.text: A punch that lands makes the opponent flash briefly.
requirements.check: When a punch connects, the opponent's sprite briefly changes color or flickers.
requirements.quote: makes it flash briefly

requirements.text: A punch that lands removes 10 health from the opponent.
requirements.check: When a punch connects, the opponent's health bar decreases by 10 units.
requirements.quote: and removes 10 health.

requirements.text: The rival walks toward the player.
requirements.check: The computer-controlled rival character moves horizontally in the direction of the player character.
requirements.quote: The rival walks toward the player

requirements.text: The rival punches when close, with a short pause between punches.
requirements.check: When the rival is within a certain distance of the player, it performs a punch action, and then waits for a short duration before punching again.
requirements.quote: and punches when close, with a short pause between punches.

requirements.text: Each fighter has 100 health.
requirements.check: Both health bars start at full capacity, representing 100 health.
requirements.quote: Each fighter has 100 health

requirements.text: Health is shown as a bar at the top of the screen.
requirements.check: Two health bars are displayed at the top of the screen, one for each fighter.
requirements.quote: shown as a bar at the top of the screen.

requirements.text: When a fighter reaches 0 health, show WIN or GAME OVER.
requirements.check: When either fighter's health bar reaches empty, the text 'WIN' or 'GAME OVER' appears on screen.
requirements.quote: When a fighter reaches 0 health, show WIN or GAME OVER

requirements.text: When a fighter reaches 0 health, freeze the game.
requirements.check: After 'WIN' or 'GAME OVER' is displayed, no further character movement or actions are possible.
requirements.quote: and freeze the game.

requirements.text: Press R to restart the fight.
requirements.check: Pressing 'R' resets the game to its initial state, with both fighters at full health and in their starting positions.
requirements.quote: Press R to restart the fight

requirements.text: Press Escape to quit the game.
requirements.check: Pressing 'Escape' closes the game window.
requirements.quote: and Escape to quit.

requirements.text: Print 'MOVE LEFT' to the console when the player moves left.
requirements.check: When the player presses the Left arrow key and moves, 'MOVE LEFT' is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: MOVE LEFT

requirements.text: Print 'MOVE RIGHT' to the console when the player moves right.
requirements.check: When the player presses the Right arrow key and moves, 'MOVE RIGHT' is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: MOVE RIGHT

requirements.text: Print 'JUMP' to the console when the player jumps.
requirements.check: When the player presses the Up arrow key and jumps, 'JUMP' is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: JUMP

requirements.text: Print 'PUNCH' to the console when the player punches.
requirements.check: When the player presses the Space key and punches, 'PUNCH' is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: PUNCH

requirements.text: Print 'RESTART' to the console when the game restarts.
requirements.check: When the player presses 'R' to restart, 'RESTART' is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: RESTART

requirements.text: Print 'QUIT' to the console when the game quits.
requirements.check: When the player presses 'Escape' to quit, 'QUIT' is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: QUIT

requirements.text: Print 'WIN' or 'GAME OVER' to the console when the fight ends.
requirements.check: When a fighter reaches 0 health, 'WIN' or 'GAME OVER' is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: and print WIN or GAME OVER when the fight ends.

requirements.text: The game should have no sounds.
requirements.check: No audio output is produced by the game.
requirements.quote: No sounds.

requirements.text: The game should be one-screen.
requirements.check: The game always displays on a single screen without transitions to other scenes.
requirements.quote: tiny one-screen

requirements.text: The game should use as few scripts as possible.
requirements.check: The game logic is contained within a minimal number of Python files.
requirements.quote: as few scripts as possible.

files.purpose: Marks the game directory as a Python package.
Main game loop, event handling, and game state management.
Defines the Fighter class, handling movement, punching, health, and rendering.
Defines the AI for the computer-controlled rival.

assets.strategy_rationale: The spec explicitly requests two small image assets for the fighters.

sprites.description: A pixel art martial artist with a red belt, facing sideways, ready to fight.
A pixel art martial artist with a blue belt, facing sideways, ready to fight.

scenes.detail: The game will operate entirely within a single Pygame display surface, handling all game elements and UI on this one screen.

architecture.test_input_example: Hold RIGHT for 1 second, then press SPACE repeatedly until WIN/GAME OVER appears. Press R to restart. Press ESCAPE to quit.
